installation.script:
#!/bin/sh
# PotenFYR Studios - Multi-Database Universal Installer
if [ -d /mnt/server ]; then
    cd /mnt/server || exit 1
elif [ -d /home/container ]; then
    cd /home/container || exit 1
else
    cd "$(pwd)" || exit 1
fi
SERVER_DIR="$(pwd)"

mkdir -p "${SERVER_DIR}/data" "${SERVER_DIR}/config" "${SERVER_DIR}/logs" "${SERVER_DIR}/bin"

# Remove any obsolete scripts copied by previous egg versions
rm -f "${SERVER_DIR}/run.sh" "${SERVER_DIR}/entrypoint.sh" 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf "${SERVER_DIR}/scripts" 2>/dev/null || true

chown -R 988:988 "${SERVER_DIR}" 2>/dev/null || true
chmod -R 755 "${SERVER_DIR}/data" "${SERVER_DIR}/config" "${SERVER_DIR}/logs" "${SERVER_DIR}/bin" 2>/dev/null || true

echo "[install] Server environment prepared successfully."

variables.name: Database Type
variables.description:
Engine to run (installed isolated inside the container on demand).
SQL: mariadb, mysql, postgresql, cockroachdb, yugabytedb, tidb, dolt
NoSQL: mongodb, ferretdb, arangodb, orientdb, ravendb, cassandra, aerospike, rethinkdb
In-Memory: redis, valkey, keydb, dragonfly, memcached, etcd, nats, immudb
Vector/Search: meilisearch, typesense, qdrant, elasticsearch, opensearch, solr, manticoresearch, milvus, weaviate, quickwit
Time-Series/Storage: influxdb, clickhouse, victoriametrics, questdb, seaweedfs, garage, minio, pocketbase
Graph/Ledger: neo4j, dgraph, surrealdb | Misc: sqld, custom

variables.name: Database Version
variables.description: Version to run. 'latest' auto-resolves upstream newest. Series like 18 or 11.4 resolve to the latest patch automatically; full versions (8.0.45) are used as-is. Switching majors never deletes old data - a fresh data/<engine>/<version> instance is created and the old one is preserved.

variables.name: Strict Version Enforcement
variables.description: 1 = refuse to start if the exact requested version cannot be provided (no silent downgrades). 0 = warn and fall back to best available binary.

variables.name: Database Name
variables.description: The default database/schema to create on startup.

variables.name: Database User Password
variables.description: Password for the application user. Leave as 'auto' to generate an ultra-strong 32+ char random cryptographic password.

variables.name: Root / Admin / Master Password
variables.description: Password for Root, Superuser, Admin, or Master Key. Leave as 'auto' to auto-generate a secure random secret.

variables.name: Auto Generate Strong Secrets
variables.description: 1 = Automatically generate cryptographically secure 32-character random passwords if fields are empty or 'auto', and update startup environment variables.

variables.name: Save Credentials to .env
variables.description: 1 = Persist database connection parameters and credentials into /home/container/.env (mode 600). Set to 0 to keep credentials strictly in process startup variables.

variables.name: Dynamic Performance Auto-Tuning
variables.description: 1 = Automatically calculate buffer pools, cache sizes, memory limits, and I/O threads based on allocated container RAM and CPU cores.

variables.name: Production Security Hardening
variables.description: 1 = Enforce SCRAM-SHA-256 encryption, drop insecure default database accounts, restrict permissions, and disable dangerous debug commands.

variables.name: Extra Daemon Arguments
variables.description: Additional custom CLI flags passed directly to the database daemon on startup.

variables.name: Extra Download URLs
variables.description: Extra files to download at install time (one per line, e.g. 'dest/name|url' or plain URL).

variables.name: Smart Companion & Extra Runtimes
variables.description: Comma-separated companion tools to dynamically inject on-demand into .runtimes/ (e.g. python, uv, nodejs, bun, litestream, rclone, aws, psql, mongosh).
